question: According to the passage, how do limitations influence creativity?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. They stimulate innovative approaches**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage states that constraints or limitations often push individuals to explore unconventional approaches, meaning they encourage or stimulate innovation. (सीमाएं अक्सर लोगों को नवाचार के लिए प्रेरित करती हैं।) • Rather than suppressing creativity, limitations can force creative problem-solving and unique solutions. • This is why supportive environments that embrace experimentation and risk-taking are important for fostering creativity. Therefore, the correct answer is- They stimulate innovative approaches [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **They suppress originality** (वे मौलिकता को दबाते हैं): The passage suggests the opposite—limitations can enhance creativity. • **They eliminate experimentation** (वे प्रयोग को समाप्त करते हैं): The passage says rigid models do this, not limitations in general. • **They reduce imagination** (वे कल्पना को कम करते हैं): The passage argues the opposite—limitations can spark imagination. 3f:T985, The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. They discourage exploration**.
